# StockBot UI

**StockBot UI** is the front-end interface for interacting with and displaying the output of the StockBot platform. It provides a structured and user-friendly way to visualize market analysis generated by various backend modules, including algorithmic and AI-driven stock prediction engines.

This UI serves as the presentation layer for StockBot, a proprietary software project developed by **Wesley Ireland**. The application is designed with a focus on clarity, usability, and integration with multiple data sources generated by the StockBot ecosystem.

## Features

- Real-time rendering of market insights and analytics
- Visual representation of outputs from traditional algorithms and TensorFlow-based AI agents
- Responsive and accessible layout optimized for both desktop and mobile use
- Disclaimer modal for legal transparency on financial data

## Project Status

This project is currently **in active development**. All source code related to StockBot and its user interface is currently private and proprietary.
